job.title: Data Engineer I, Secure Third Party Tools (S3T)
job.pay_full: $101,300 – $160,000 a year base salary (Austin), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Security Foundations builds solutions that keep Amazon's systems and data secure, using automation and machine learning to reduce manual effort at Amazon scale. Within it, Secure 3P Tools (S3T) is a central Amazon Security team that keeps data secure and services available across all third-party interactions; its customers include end consumers, Amazon businesses working with third parties, and internal compliance teams. This Data Engineer I works with software engineers, other data engineers and applied scientists to design and build data solutions for the vendors that do business with Amazon and for Amazon's own builders.
duties: Design, implement and support a platform that gives secure access to large datasets
Architect, develop and maintain end-to-end scalable data infrastructure and pipelines
Help set the team's data strategy and technical roadmap for storage and pipelines
Extract, transform and load data from many sources with SQL, scripting and AWS big data technologies
Design and implement complex ETL pipelines and other BI solutions
Work with business owners, developers and BI engineers to explore and deliver new data sources
Help the team self-serve on complex data tasks and troubleshooting
needs: Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with one or more query languages (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
Experience with one or more scripting languages (e.g., Python, KornShell)
nice: Big data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark and EMR
An ETL tool such as Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI or DataStage
details.benefits: Base salary $101,300 – $160,000 a year (Austin, Texas). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life plans, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon Security encourages candidates to apply even if they don't meet every qualification
Flexible work hours and arrangements are part of the team's culture
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
